title: Shared value formats
description: The one definition of each value format used by many schemas (brief L). A schema references a kind with {"$ref": "common/formats.schema.json#/$defs/<kind>"} instead of copying its pattern or enum; schema_format_lint.py fails on a new inline copy. Patterns use the validator's Python dialect: '\\Z' is end-of-string, so a trailing newline never passes. formats.py is the Python side and reads its patterns from this file.

sha256_ref.description: SHA-256 digest with its algorithm prefix: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.

sha256_hex.description: Bare SHA-256 digest: 64 lowercase hex (execution_state.digest, envelope and pointer hashes).

sha256_ref_or_hex.description: Reader-tolerant digest: sha256_ref or sha256_hex. Writers use one of the two.

git_sha1.description: Full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex.

utc_timestamp.description: UTC instant, whole seconds, Z suffix (formats.utc_now()).

identifier.description: Run/job/attempt identifier, the pattern of execution_state.identifier() (which also rejects Windows device names).

slug.description: Registry id (persona, role, domain, profile): lowercase, hyphenated, 1-96 chars.

dotted_id.description: Id with dots/underscores allowed, mixed case, 1-96 chars.

ok_status.description: Terminal success statuses of a published result.
